scope: Client developer isolated VM fixtures; not browser, actual HTTP/BGE, independent QA or user acceptance

tests.name: Five statuses remain distinct and invalid input stays editable with no network
Every short sentence, source hash/path/title/href/quote offset and context must match public corpus
Uses anonymous same-origin dialogue endpoint, plain text question/message and collapsed quoted sources
Verified canonical topic only, related/filtered scope and explicit context origin are shown
Pending same expression prevents duplicates; newer question suppresses old late answer/error/finally
Collapse while waiting and page navigation remain; completion cannot reopen or steal reading focus
Retry uses frozen submitted text and context despite changed draft or page
Clear topic invalidates pending identity; old late answer cannot restore theme
History and refresh recheck source; old query key and seeded user records remain untouched
IME confirmation and Shift+Enter do not send; normal Enter does; clarified option sends full server expression
Static file mode honestly unavailable and source failure clears answer/cards
